The Blazor Web App is ready. Here's what was built:

**Project structure:**
```
UniversityCourseCatalog/
├── Models/          — Department, Course, Instructor, EnrollmentRequest
├── Services/        — CatalogService (in-memory seed data, search/filter)
├── Components/
│   ├── Pages/
│   │   ├── Home.razor          — Featured courses + department links
│   │   ├── Courses.razor       — Searchable, filterable course list
│   │   ├── CourseDetail.razor   — Full details, schedule, instructor bio
│   │   ├── Enroll.razor        — Enrollment request form with validation
│   │   └── Error/NotFound
│   └── Layout/                 — Updated nav with Courses & Enroll links
└── Program.cs                  — CatalogService registered as singleton
```

**Key features:**
- **Static SSR** — ideal for intranet with fast connectivity
- **Search & filter** — by keyword and department via query parameters
- **Course details** — description, credits, schedule, location, instructor bio
- **Enrollment form** — standard HTML form with `DataAnnotationsValidator`, enhanced navigation
- **6 departments, 15 courses, 8 instructors** seeded as sample data

Run with `dotnet run --project UniversityCourseCatalog`.
